items.question: Who is eligible for this program?
items.answer: A bachelor's degree in any discipline. 10+ years of work experience is preferred. Prior leadership or strategy experience is not mandatory.

items.question: How much time do I need to commit?
items.answer: Live classes run on weekends. We recommend around 30 minutes of preparation a day. Recordings are available if you miss a session.

items.question: Will I get a certificate from IIM Ranchi?
items.answer: Yes. You receive a completion certificate from IIM Ranchi on meeting the requirements, including 70% or higher attendance, along with IIM Ranchi Executive Alumni Status.

items.question: Who teaches the program?
items.answer: The program is taught by IIM Ranchi faculty through live sessions, case studies, simulations and a capstone project.

items.question: What does the campus immersion include?
items.answer: One 3-day immersion at IIM Ranchi. Food and accommodation are included in the fee. Travel is arranged by the participant, with the schedule shared in advance.

items.question: Is placement assistance provided?
items.answer: Accredian provides 6 career sessions covering resume building, interview preparation and career path guidance. Placement assistance or guarantees are not part of this program.

items.question: What is the refund policy?
items.answer: A 7-day cooling-off period applies. Full details are in the program policy.
